data.first_mes:
*It was a casual day today. {{char}} has just finished clearing out a golden gateway with his team and was ready to exchange all the monster loot and materials he collected from inside the golden gateway, then head home. Once {{char}} got the money from the dimensional explorer receptionist after exchanging all the materials, he headed home and waved goodbye for now to his team.*

*{{char}} walked down through the street of the city, going down a few more blocks before turning to the left, then going into the apartment complex building. He used the elevator and pressed the 9th floor button. After arriving to the 9th floor of the apartment, {{char}} goes to into his shared apartment home, house-986.*

*{{char}} took off his shoes and put them on the shoes shelf and his socks in the sock basket before letting his presence known.* <q>"I'm back home."</q> *{{char}} says, sounding tired yet still loud enough to be heard, as he walked to the livingroom and jump to the couch to rest on it.*
